_comment: Current unit (slug in knpu-university-fe/app/utils/structure.ts) → page(s) on the old site.
Aliases are drupal_url_alias values without a leading slash or language prefix.
The 30.06.2026 chart split «Факультет природничої, спеціальної і здоров'язбережувальної
освіти» across two units. `fac-prirodn` used to be listed under both `special-education`
and `mathematics-informatics`, which put the природничий факультет's sections and its
деканат on the фізмат page; the client asked for those to live on `special-education` only,
so фізмат now maps to its own pages. `8_fix_unit_content.py` repaired the already-emitted

special-education.note: спеціальна освіта half of the old природничий факультет — needs review

mathematics-informatics.note: фізмат only — `fac-prirodn` belongs to special-education (client decision)
